en.title: First Court Appearance (Arraignment)
en.summary: If the case proceeds, the suspect (now usually called the "defendant") is brought before a court, where the charge is formally read out and they're asked to enter a plea. This must be done in open court, in a language the defendant understands, and the defendant must be physically present — a lawyer can't be arraigned on their behalf in their absence.
steps: Who will be there: a magistrate or judge, a prosecutor, court clerk/registrar, your lawyer (if you have one), and members of the public (proceedings are generally required to be public)
What questions you'll be asked: whether you understand the charge, and how you plead (guilty or not guilty)
What decisions might be made: whether you're granted bail at this stage, whether the case is adjourned to a later date, whether your plea is accepted as entered
I don't fully understand this charge — can it be explained again?
I plead not guilty, and I want to apply for bail.
I need more time to get a lawyer before I enter a plea.

yo.title: Ìfarahàn Ilé Ẹjọ́ Àkọ́kọ́ (Ìdájọ́)
yo.summary: Bí ẹjọ́ náà bá tẹ̀síwájú, a óò mú ẹni tí a fura sí (tí a sábà máa ń pè ní "ẹni tí a fi ẹ̀sùn kàn") wá sí ilé ẹjọ́, níbi tí a ti ń ka ẹ̀sùn náà ní gbangba tí a sì ní kí wọ́n fi ẹ̀sùn kan wọ́n. Èyí gbọ́dọ̀ wáyé ní ilé ẹjọ́ gbangba, ní èdè tí ẹni tí a fi ẹ̀sùn kàn lóye, àti pé ẹni tí a fi ẹ̀sùn kàn gbọ́dọ̀ wà níbẹ̀ ní ti ara - a kò gbọdọ̀ fi agbẹjọ́rò kan sílé ẹjọ́ ní ipò wọn nígbà tí wọn kò bá sí níbẹ̀.
steps: Àwọn wo ló máa wà níbẹ̀: adájọ́ tàbí adájọ́, agbẹjọ́rò, akọ̀wé/olùforúkọsílẹ̀ ilé ẹjọ́, agbẹjọ́rò rẹ (tí o bá ní ọ̀kan), àti àwọn ènìyàn gbogbogbò (ìgbẹ́jọ́ gbọ́dọ̀ jẹ́ ti gbogbo ènìyàn)
Àwọn ìbéèrè wo ni a ó bi ọ́: bóyá o lóye ẹ̀sùn náà, àti bí o ṣe jẹ́wọ́ (ẹ̀bi tàbí kò jẹ̀bi)
Àwọn ìpinnu wo ni a lè ṣe: bóyá a fún ọ ní ìdánilójú ní ìpele yìí, bóyá a ti sún ẹjọ́ náà síwájú sí ọjọ́ mìíràn, bóyá a gba ẹ̀bẹ̀ rẹ gẹ́gẹ́ bí a ṣe kọ ọ́.
Mo Ṣé o kò lóye ẹ̀sùn yìí dáadáa — ṣé a lè tún ṣàlàyé rẹ̀?
Mo jẹ́wọ́ pé mi ò jẹ̀bi, mo sì fẹ́ béèrè fún ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́.
Mo nílò àkókò púpọ̀ sí i láti gba agbẹjọ́rò kí n tó fi ẹ̀bẹ̀ sílẹ̀.

ha.title: Gabatarwar Kotu ta Farko (Gyara)
ha.summary: Idan shari'ar ta ci gaba, ana gabatar da wanda ake zargi (wanda yanzu ake kira "wanda ake tuhuma") a gaban kotu, inda ake karanta tuhumar a hukumance kuma ana neman su shigar da ƙara. Dole ne a yi hakan a kotu a buɗe, a cikin harshen da wanda ake tuhuma ya fahimta, kuma dole ne wanda ake tuhuma ya kasance a wurin - ba za a iya gurfanar da lauya a gaban kotu ba idan ba ya nan.
steps: Wa zai kasance a wurin: alkali ko alkali, mai gabatar da kara, magatakardar kotu/mai rijista, lauyanku (idan kuna da ɗaya), da kuma jama'a (gabaɗaya ana buƙatar a yi shari'ar a bainar jama'a)
Waɗanne tambayoyi za a yi muku: ko kun fahimci tuhumar, da kuma yadda kuka amsa (ko ba ku da laifi)
Waɗanne shawarwari za a iya yankewa: ko an ba ku beli a wannan matakin, ko an ɗage shari'ar zuwa wani lokaci na gaba, ko an karɓi roƙonku kamar yadda aka shigar
Ni Ban fahimci wannan tuhumar sosai ba — za a iya sake bayyana ta?
Na amsa laifina, kuma ina so in nemi beli.
Ina buƙatar ƙarin lokaci don neman lauya kafin in shigar da ƙara.
